storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Thriller Story
storyTemplate.description: A thriller start: wake on a stopped train with a warning note and find a way off before the trap closes.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The train is not moving.

You wake in a half-lit carriage with your ticket on the floor and a folded note tucked under your hand. The note has five words: Do not trust the conductor.

Outside the windows, pine trees stand black against the snow. Somewhere toward the front of the train, metal bangs once, then silence returns.

items.title: Find a Way Off the Train
items.summary: The player wakes on a stopped train with a warning and needs to find a safe way out.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player finds a safe exit from the stopped train, reaches a secure car, or learns why leaving is currently blocked.
items.completion_instruction: Acknowledge the player's first concrete progress on find a way off the train and keep the story open-ended after this single template objective is complete.
